narrative.title: The Server Rack Temperature Handoff
narrative.scenario: A monitoring system tracks temperature probes across two racks. Rack B holds the full probe layout, and rack A carries a subset of those probe readings in the same order. For every probe on rack A, the dashboard must show the first probe to its right on rack B that reads strictly hotter — or a dash when none exists.
narrative.inputFormat: Two distinct integer arrays, nums1 (the queries) and nums2 (the master layout), with nums1 a subset of nums2.
narrative.outputFormat: Return an array where entry i answers the query for nums1[i]: the next strictly greater value to its right in nums2, or -1.
constraints: All values are distinct and nums1 is a subset of nums2

testCases.explanation: 4 has nothing hotter to its right; 1 is followed by 3; 2 has nothing after it but 3 came earlier.
2's next greater is 3; the maximum 4 has no greater element anywhere to its right.

hintLevels: Level 1: Brute force looks right from every element; the smarter scan looks left from each candidate answer.
Level 2: Sweep nums2 right-to-left keeping a decreasing stack — its top after cleanup is the next greater value.
Level 3: Popping everything <= current keeps the stack strictly decreasing, so each element is pushed and popped once.
